row:
Welcome to the Parr PT channel.

We provide specialized physical therapy treatments in Austin & Houston for: EDS (Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome), hypermobility, Dysautonomia, POTS, chronic pain & chronic fatigue (e.g. Fibromyalgia), neurological disorders & brain injuries such as strokes and MS, sports rehab & injury prevention for athletes, scar tissue release, bowel disorders (constipation, IBS, gastroparesis), and Matrix gait training.

Our expert physical therapists have years of experience in helping people with complex conditions to lead healthier and happier lives (https://parrpt.com/patient-testimonials/). At our clinic, you can expect personalized, one-on-one treatments tailored exactly to your needs:

The Parr PT Method = Specific myokinesethics techniques + Hands-on manual therapy + A holistic exercise approach to PT = Optimal Results!

Contact us directly today: https://parrpt.com/contact-and-scheduling/

Jonathan Parr PT, CSCS EP MCMT CBIS
